name: english-text-density-dataset
title: Characters per Word in English: 250 Text Samples
description: Character counts and text density measurements from 250 English samples of 500 words, across five text types. Includes the error of the six-character estimate, methodology and source links.

resources.name: measurements-csv
resources.title: measurements.csv
resources.description: 250 sample-level records and 11 columns; primary analysis table.

fields.name: public_sample_id
fields.description: Stable sample identifier; joins measurements to the source register.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Text type: news, general_informational, academic, technical_instructional or classic_fiction.

fields.name: subdiscipline
fields.description: Academic subject group; blank for other categories.

fields.name: moltoyo_words
fields.description: Whitespace-separated tokens under the study definition; always 500.

fields.name: characters_with_spaces
fields.description: Unicode code points in the normalized sample, including spaces.

fields.name: sample_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the normalized sample; does not establish rights.

fields.name: sample_start_locator
fields.description: Zero-based starting token index in the normalized source document.

fields.name: sample_end_locator
fields.description: Zero-based ending token index, inclusive; start + 499.

resources.name: measurements-json
resources.title: measurements.json
resources.description: The same 250 measurements in a JSON object under rows.

resources.name: sources-json
resources.title: sources.json
resources.description: Document-level source URLs under sources; no original prose.

resources.name: methodology-json
resources.title: methodology.json
resources.description: Sampling, definitions, source mix, results and rights scope.

resources.name: metadata-errata-json
resources.title: metadata-errata.json
resources.description: Eight source-date corrections, including seven licence corrections; measurements unchanged.

license_scope: Only original measurements, compilation and documentation owned by Moltoyo. Third-party source works and rights excluded; no prose distributed.
